notes.title: OUR FIRST MAINTENANCE UPDATE
notes.notes:
ATTENTION EVERYONE THAT BOUGHT THE GAME - DO NOT ENTER THE LAB IN FUTURE, IT MAY SET YOUR PC ON FIRE. 

Ok, it will crash the game, nothing is set on fire. But listen, we have no idea how to fix - so here's what we're gonna do. We'll create the Hall of Crashes in the game - send your screenshot with the crash and your Steam username and we'll put it in the Hall of Crashes.

Also, we just figured out something: Bethesda is worth 7.5 billion dollars. We're worth around 0.0000026 Bethesdas. So, if you loved Skyrim, that's more or less the amount you'll love this game.

Also, I'm black so if you give us a negative review, you're racist.

Cheers.
